hookgate.missing_root: missing repo root (the second argument must be an absolute path)
hookgate.not_a_suite_repo: '%(repo)s' has no zreflect/ — this is not a repo the suite was installed into, or GATE_REPO points at the wrong place
hookgate.push_nothing_to_check: no branch carries new content (tag/deletion) ⇒ the README criterion has nothing to check here (said out loud, not pretending it checked)
hookgate.push_readmes_not_together: %(ref)s: this push did not update the three READMEs **together** (CI runs the same criterion; --no-verify only bypasses it locally). Roster configurable: REFLECT_READMES.
hookgate.ref_has_nothing: %(ref)s carries no new content ⇒ the README criterion has nothing to check for it (said out loud)
hookgate.repo_missing: repo root '%(repo)s' does not exist (the second argument must be an absolute path)
